text: Pellet, Joomi maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- O Ñaawiray hakkunde yimɓe ɓen gomɗinɓe maɓɓe e yedduɓe ɓe maɓɓe Ñalnde Darngal Ñaawoore Makko Nunɗunde nden, O Yurminoya gomɗinɓe ɓen, O Lepta yedduɓe ɓen, ko Kanko woni Tedduɗo yoɓtotooɗo On ayɓe Makko ɓen. Hay e gooto foolataa Mo, Annduɗo On Mo faydindirtaa moƴƴinɗo e bonnuɗo.
